items.title_en: OpenAI Invites Some Plus Users to Test dots AI Agent; Mobile ChatGPT to Add a Dedicated Tab
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，OpenAI 核心产品负责人蒂博 · 索蒂奥（Thibault Sottiaux）今天（11 月 20 日）在 X 平台发布推文， 宣布邀请少量 ChatGPT Plus 用户测试 dots，同时宣布向所有 ChatGPT Business Standard 用户开放。 IT之家今年 9 月报道，在 OpenAI DevDay 2026 活动中，OpenAI 发布了 dots 全天候智能助理，用户交代目标、提供背景并连接所需应用后，可以后台帮助用户规划议程、设计网站、测试应用、修改笔记等。 有别于传统一问一答方式，dots 拥有自己的云电脑，可以使用你连接的应用开展研究、制作成果，并根据你的反馈逐渐适应工作偏好。你可以规定哪些事情允许它自行处理，哪些需要你参与决定。 索蒂奥还透露正在测试全新的移动端使用体验，重点调整功能入口与底部标签栏，让用户更容易找到常用工具，也能更直观地发现 ChatGPT 的其他用途。 新体验将首先面向已拥有 dots，或具备创建 dot 资格的 ChatGPT Pro 用户开放，本次改版为用户的 dots 设置独立标签页，使其拥有更直接的访问入口。 与此同时，用户可以将 Codex、Projects（项目）、Images（图像）等功能固定到底部标签栏，按照自己的使用习惯安排常用入口，减少查找功能的步骤。新版界面并非强制启用。用户可以随时进入“设置”，通过“New ChatGPT Design”选项开启或关闭新体验。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 20: Thibault Sottiaux, OpenAI's core product lead, posted on X on Nov 20 that OpenAI is inviting a small number of ChatGPT Plus users to test dots and is opening it to all ChatGPT Business Standard users. IT Home reported in September that at OpenAI DevDay 2026, OpenAI launched dots, an always-on intelligent assistant: after users give a goal, provide context and connect the needed apps, it can work in the background to help plan agendas, design websites, test apps and edit notes. Unlike the traditional Q&A model, dots has its own cloud computer, can use the apps users connect to conduct research and produce outputs, and gradually adapts to work preferences based on feedback. Users can specify what it may handle on its own and what requires user decisions. Sottiaux also said a new mobile experience is being tested, focusing on adjusting feature entry points and the bottom tab bar so users can more easily find frequently used tools and more intuitively discover other ChatGPT uses. The new experience will first open to ChatGPT Pro users who already have dots or are eligible to create a dot; it gives dots a dedicated tab for more direct access. Users can also pin Codex, Projects, Images and other features to the bottom tab bar to arrange frequent entry points according to their habits. The new interface is not mandatory; users can enter Settings at any time and turn the new experience on or off via the 'New ChatGPT Design' option.
items.why_zh: 推测：dots 从邀请测试扩展到商业用户，并获移动端独立入口，显示 OpenAI 正推动智能体从实验功能转向更常态化的产品入口。
items.why_en: Speculation: Moving dots from invite-only testing to Business Standard users and giving it a dedicated mobile tab suggests OpenAI is pushing its agent from an experimental feature toward a more regular product entry point.

items.title_zh: 三星安卓笔记本再曝细节：让 App 适配键鼠操作，整合手机端 AI 技能
items.title_en: Samsung Android Laptop Details Leak: Keyboard and Mouse Adaptation for Apps, Phone AI Features Integration
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，科技媒体 sammyguru 昨日（11 月 19 日）发布博文，通过挖掘 One UI 9.5 首个 Beta 测试版，发现了三星安卓笔记本的更多线索， 有望适配智能简报 Now Brief、主动建议功能 Now Nudge 等 AI 功能。 IT之家今天援引 Android Authority 媒体报道，在该 Beta 测试版中发现 origin14wifi 和 origin16wifi 两款设备踪迹，型号分别是 XE940 和 XE960，将会搭载高通骁龙 X Elite 芯片。 外观方面，从曝光的示意图来看，两款产品可能对应 14 英寸和 16 英寸，采用传统翻盖设计，目前发现的线索指向仅支持 Wi-Fi 的版本。 硬件方面，在三星视频编辑应用新增的芯片配置中，代号 Origin 的设备关联高通 12 核骁龙 X Elite（X1E-80-100）处理器。此外型号为 XE940XSA 的设备也曾现身 Geekbench，显示运行 Android 17、配备 16GB 内存。 在 AI 功能方面，代号 Origin 的设备适配多项手机 AI 功能，涵盖智能简报 Now Brief、主动建议功能 Now Nudge，以及日历、录音机等应用等。 此外，为上述 AI 功能提供支持的 Personal Data Intelligence 应用，已能区分移动设备与笔记本、台式机，并切换相应的文字、布局和插图。 笔记本端说明提到，系统可根据用户的使用习惯，在三星及第三方应用中提供信息和操作建议，包括简报更新、添加日程及发送消息等。 其中，Now Nudge 的适配插图展示了两类用途，其一是参考过去的聊天记录、截图等内容，帮助用户回溯信息，其二是根据当前屏幕内容，推荐下一步操作。 其他应用也出现键鼠操作适配：Memory“我的收藏”提供快捷键截屏保存提示；录音机则为 AI 摘要加入复制、翻译、分享等右键菜单，设置与搜索也改用桌面式弹出菜单。 相关阅读： 《 One UI 9.5 Beta 1 暗藏三星笔电信息：采用高通骁龙 X Elite 芯片 》
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 20: Tech media sammyguru published a post on Nov 19 saying that by digging into the first One UI 9.5 Beta, it found more clues about Samsung's Android laptop, which is expected to support AI features such as Now Brief and proactive suggestions Now Nudge. IT Home today cited Android Authority as reporting that traces of two devices, origin14wifi and origin16wifi, model numbers XE940 and XE960, were found in the beta; they will use Qualcomm Snapdragon X Elite chips. In terms of appearance, leaked sketches suggest the two products may correspond to 14-inch and 16-inch models with a traditional clamshell design; clues found so far point to Wi-Fi-only versions. On hardware, in a newly added chip configuration in Samsung's video editing app, devices codenamed Origin are linked to Qualcomm's 12-core Snapdragon X Elite (X1E-80-100) processor. In addition, a device with model number XE940XSA previously appeared on Geekbench, showing Android 17 and 16GB of memory. On AI features, devices codenamed Origin support multiple phone AI features, covering Now Brief, Now Nudge, and apps such as Calendar and Voice Recorder. In addition, the Personal Data Intelligence app that supports these AI features can already distinguish mobile devices from laptops and desktops and switch corresponding text, layouts and illustrations. The laptop-side description says the system can, based on user habits, provide information and action suggestions in Samsung and third-party apps, including briefing updates, adding calendar events and sending messages. The adaptation illustration for Now Nudge shows two types of uses: one is to help users recall information by referring to past chat records, screenshots and other content; the other is to recommend next steps based on current screen content. Other apps also show keyboard and mouse adaptation: Memory's My Favorites provides a shortcut screenshot-save prompt; Voice Recorder adds right-click menus such as copy, translate and share to AI summaries; Settings and Search also switch to desktop-style pop-up menus. Related reading: 'One UI 9.5 Beta 1 Hides Samsung Laptop Information: Uses Qualcomm Snapdragon X Elite Chip.'
items.why_zh: 推测：若三星将手机端 AI 与桌面交互结合，安卓笔记本可能成为其跨设备 AI 体验的新形态；目前仅为 Beta 线索，未获官方确认。
items.why_en: Speculation: If Samsung combines phone AI with desktop interaction, Android laptops could become a new form of its cross-device AI experience; these are only beta clues and have not been officially confirmed.

items.title_zh: 行业首次：小鹏 2026 科技日将首发「图灵 AI 共驾」，把智能辅助驾驶能力赋能人驾
items.title_en: Industry First: XPeng to Debut 'Turing AI Co-Driving' at 2026 Tech Day, Bringing Assisted Driving Capabilities to Human Driving
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，小鹏汽车 2026 年小鹏科技日（AI DAY）已经官宣定档 11 月 25 日在广州举行，主题为“原点”（Origin）。 据小鹏介绍，本届科技日的核心发布之一，是“图灵 AI 共驾”的首次亮相。小鹏表示，这是行业首次将智能辅助驾驶能力延伸至人工驾驶场景。 其首个落地功能为“VLA 自适应减速”，该功能在驾驶员松开加速踏板时介入，由后台运行的 VLA 大模型对前方路况进行实时判断，并将场景理解结果传递给整车控制器，由其融合踏板操作与硬件边界后，平顺调节减速力度。系统无需开启导航辅助驾驶即可生效，目标是在人驾滑行与减速过程中减少突兀的拖拽感，降低晕车概率。 在能耗层面，小鹏官方公布的数据显示，在城市拥堵工况下，开启 VLA 自适应减速（对比关闭能量回收）可使实际可用续航提升 12.4%。这一收益来自回收策略对路况的预判，而非简单地提高回收强度。VLA 模型能够识别前车减速、路口红灯或弯道等场景，提前调整回收扭矩，减少不必要的机械制动介入。 这一功能将首发应用于小鹏 G9L 与小鹏 MONA L05 两款车型。其中，小鹏 G9L 于 2026 年 9 月 17 日上市，定位大五座 SUV，限时售价 23.18 万元起，首发搭载第二代 VLA 智驾系统；MONA L05 于 10 月 29 日上市，限时起售价 13.98 万元，其 Ultra SE 版本搭载图灵第二代 VLA 完整模型。小鹏方面表示，该功能未来将面向更多车型逐步推送。 据介绍，“图灵 AI 共驾”的技术底座是小鹏全栈自研的图灵 AI 芯片与 VLA 模型。图灵芯片自 2025 年第三季度量产上车，截至 2026 年 8 月累计出货量已超过 20 万片。 VLA（IT之家注：视觉-语言-动作模型，Vision-Language-Action）的作用是让车辆在人工驾驶状态下仍能持续理解视觉场景，为底层控制策略提供预判输入，而非直接取代驾驶员操作。 除图灵 AI 共驾外，本届小鹏科技日还将展示物理 AI 与机器人方向的最新进展。小鹏人形机器人 Iron 计划登台与观众互动，活动时间紧邻 11 月 27 日开幕的 2026 广州车展。敬请期待。 相关阅读： 《 2026 小鹏科技日定档 11 月 25 日，宣传语“Origin 原点” 》
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 20: XPeng Motors' 2026 XPeng AI DAY has been officially scheduled for Nov 25 in Guangzhou, with the theme 'Origin.' According to XPeng, one of the core announcements will be the first appearance of 'Turing AI Co-Driving.' XPeng says this is the industry's first extension of intelligent assisted driving capabilities to manual driving scenarios. Its first deployed function is 'VLA Adaptive Deceleration.' When the driver releases the accelerator pedal, the function intervenes: the VLA large model running in the background makes real-time judgments about the road ahead and passes scene-understanding results to the vehicle controller, which integrates pedal operation and hardware boundaries to smoothly adjust deceleration. The system works without navigation-assisted driving being enabled; the goal is to reduce abrupt drag during human-driven coasting and deceleration and lower the probability of motion sickness. On energy consumption, XPeng's official data shows that in urban congestion conditions, enabling VLA Adaptive Deceleration (compared with turning off energy recuperation) can increase actual usable range by 12.4%. This benefit comes from the recuperation strategy's prediction of road conditions, rather than simply increasing recuperation strength. The VLA model can identify scenarios such as the front vehicle decelerating, a red light at an intersection or a curve, adjust recuperation torque in advance and reduce unnecessary mechanical braking intervention. The function will debut on the XPeng G9L and XPeng MONA L05. The G9L launched on Sept 17, 2026, positioned as a large five-seat SUV, with a limited-time price starting at 231,800 yuan, and debuts the second-generation VLA assisted driving system; the MONA L05 launched on Oct 29, with a limited-time starting price of 139,800 yuan, and its Ultra SE version carries the full second-generation Turing VLA model. XPeng says the function will gradually roll out to more models in the future. According to XPeng, the technical foundation of 'Turing AI Co-Driving' is its fully self-developed Turing AI chip and VLA model. The Turing chip entered mass production and vehicle installation in Q3 2025; as of Aug 2026, cumulative shipments exceeded 200,000 units. VLA (Vision-Language-Action) enables the vehicle to continue understanding visual scenes while under manual driving and provide predictive input for underlying control strategies, rather than directly replacing the driver's operation. In addition to Turing AI Co-Driving, this year's XPeng AI DAY will also show the latest progress in physical AI and robotics. XPeng's humanoid robot Iron is planned to appear on stage and interact with the audience; the event is close to the 2026 Guangzhou Auto Show opening on Nov 27. Related reading: '2026 XPeng AI DAY Scheduled for Nov 25, Slogan Origin.'

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，小鹏汽车 2026 年小鹏科技日（AI DAY）已经官宣定档 11 月 25 日在广州举行，主题为“原点”（Origin）。 据小鹏介绍，本届科技日的核心发布之一，是“图灵 AI 共驾”的首次亮相。小鹏表示，这是行业首次将智能辅助驾驶能力延伸至人工驾驶场景。 其首个落地功能为“VLA 自适应减速”，该功能在驾驶员松开加速踏板时介入，由后台运行的 VLA 大模型对前方路况进行实时判断，并将场景理解结果传递给整车控制器，由其融合踏板操作与硬件边界后，平顺调节减速力度。系统无需开启导航辅助驾驶即可生效，目标是在人驾滑行与减速过程中减少突兀的拖拽感，降低晕车概率。 在能耗层面，小鹏官方公布的数据显示，在城市拥堵工况下，开启 VLA 自适应减速（对比关闭能量回收）可使实际可用续航提升 12.4%。这一收益来自回收策略对路况的预判，而非简单地提高回收强度。VLA 模型能够识别前车减速、路口红灯或弯道等场景，提前调整回收扭矩，减少不必要的机械制动介入。 这一功能将首发应用于小鹏 G9L 与小鹏 MONA L05 两款车型。其中，小鹏 G9L 于 2026 年 9 月 17 日上市，定位大五座 SUV，限时售价 23.18 万元起，首发搭载第二代 VLA 智驾系统；MONA L05 于 10 月 29 日上市，限时起售价 13.98 万元，其 Ultra SE 版本搭载图灵第二代 VLA 完整模型。小鹏方面表示，该功能未来将面向更多车型逐步推送。 据介绍，“图灵 AI 共驾”的技术底座是小鹏全栈自研的图灵 AI 芯片与 VLA 模型。图灵芯片自 2025 年第三季度量产上车，截至 2026 年 8 月累计出货量已超过 20 万片。 VLA（IT之家注：视觉-语言-动作模型，Vision-Language-Action）的作用是让车辆在人工驾驶状态下仍能持续理解视觉场景，为底层控制策略提供预判输入，而非直接取代驾驶员操作。 除图灵 AI 共驾外，本届小鹏科技日还将展示物理 AI 与机器人方向的最新进展。小鹏人形机器人 Iron 计划登台与观众互动，活动时间紧邻 11 月 27 日开幕的 2026 广州车展。敬请期待。 相关阅读： 《 2026 小鹏科技日定档 11 月 25 日，宣传语“Origin 原点” 》

items.title_zh: 国内推出首个智能座舱 AI 分级评价体系，共分为 C1 到 C5 五级
items.title_en: China Launches First Smart Cockpit AI Grading System, Divided Into C1 to C5
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，据央视新闻今日报道，随着新能源汽车快速普及，日前，中国汽车技术研究中心推出了国内首个汽车智能座舱 AI 能力分级评价体系。 IT之家从报道获悉，这次中汽中心推出的 AI 能力分级评价体系， 共分为 C1 到 C5 五级 ，把座舱 AI 主观体验转化为可量化的评价指标，覆盖八大能力和行为属性、九大用车场景。 中汽智能科技副总经理张亚楠表示：“我们这一体系提炼了智能座舱的感知、执行、自主、进化等八大能力，并与智慧出行、情感陪伴和健康关怀等九大场景交叉匹配，生成体系化的数据库，使评价贴近真实用车场景。我们已依据体系开展了首批验证，为消费者购车提供了汽车智能座舱 AI 能力客观评判标尺。” 中汽中心的调查显示，目前，20 万元以上的国产新能源汽车座舱 AI 搭载率超过了 90%，日均座舱交互超 3000 万次。 2026 年，国内智能座舱市场规模预计超过 1800 亿元 ，座舱的智能化体验已成为消费者购车的核心考量。 延伸阅读 2026 年 5 月，工业和信息化部等三部门联合发布《人工智能终端智能化分级》（GB/Z 177—2026）系列国家标准，明确将汽车座舱纳入首批分级品类，并采用 L1 至 L4 四个等级（响应级、工具级、辅助级、协同级）进行划分，与此次中汽中心推出的 C1-C5 分级体系并行，共同构成座舱 AI 评价的“标尺”。 市场层面，数据显示中国智能座舱解决方案市场规模 2025 年约为 1544 亿元，2026 年预计达到 1828 亿元，其中软件规模预计约 605 亿元、占比约 33%；2026 年国内智能座舱渗透率预计超过 80%。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 20: CCTV News reported today that with the rapid spread of new energy vehicles, the China Automotive Technology and Research Center (CATARC) recently launched China's first grading and evaluation system for smart cockpit AI capabilities. According to the report, CATARC's AI capability grading system has five levels, C1 to C5, turning subjective cockpit AI experience into quantifiable evaluation indicators, covering eight major capability and behavioral attributes and nine major vehicle-use scenarios. Zhang Yanan, deputy general manager of CATARC Intelligent Technology, said: 'Our system distills eight major capabilities of smart cockpits, including perception, execution, autonomy and evolution, and cross-matches them with nine scenarios such as smart travel, emotional companionship and health care to generate a systematic database, making the evaluation close to real vehicle-use scenarios. We have carried out initial verification according to the system, providing consumers with an objective yardstick for judging smart cockpit AI capabilities when buying cars.' CATARC's survey shows that currently, the cockpit AI installation rate in domestic new energy vehicles priced above 200,000 yuan exceeds 90%, with more than 30 million cockpit interactions per day. In 2026, China's smart cockpit market is expected to exceed 180 billion yuan, and smart cockpit experience has become a core consideration for consumers buying cars. Extended reading: In May 2026, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and two other departments jointly released the national standard series 'Artificial Intelligence Terminal Intelligence Grading' (GB/Z 177-2026), which explicitly includes automotive cockpits among the first batch of graded categories and uses four levels, L1 to L4 (response level, tool level, auxiliary level, collaborative level), running in parallel with CATARC's C1-C5 system to jointly form a yardstick for cockpit AI evaluation. On the market side, data shows China's smart cockpit solution market was about 154.4 billion yuan in 2025 and is expected to reach 182.8 billion yuan in 2026, of which software is expected to be about 60.5 billion yuan, accounting for about 33%; in 2026, domestic smart cockpit penetration is expected to exceed 80%.
items.why_zh: 推测：分级体系可能为消费者提供可比较的座舱 AI 标尺，并影响车企宣传与产品设计；其实际约束力取决于后续采用情况。
items.why_en: Speculation: The grading system may give consumers a comparable yardstick for cockpit AI and influence automakers' marketing and product design; its actual binding force depends on later adoption.

items.title_zh: 曝 Meta 全新 AI 硬件 Muse Charm 售 300 美元，附赠一年 5G 流量
items.title_en: Report: Meta's New AI Hardware Muse Charm Priced at $300, With One Year of 5G Data
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，据《The Information》今日报道，Meta 旗下新款 AI 硬件设备 Muse Charm 的售价约为 300 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 2,008 元人民币） ，并将附赠最长 12 个月的 5G 流量服务（Verizon 提供）。 Muse Charm 是一款配备屏幕的小型 AI 设备，由 Meta CEO 马克 · 扎克伯格（Mark Zuckerberg）于今年 9 月的 Meta Connect 大会上首次展示。扎克伯格当时表示，该设备计划于 12 月假日购物季期间上市，但没有公布具体售价。 Meta 计划通过这款掌上设备，让用户无需打开手机应用，即可直接与旗下 Muse AI 智能体进行语音交互。 扎克伯格介绍称，Muse Charm 集成了 Muse 的实时语音交互和虚拟形象技术，设备配备指纹传感器。用户触碰指纹传感器即可启动交互，直接与 Muse AI 智能体对话，无需解锁手机或打开应用程序。设备还配备约 2 英寸（约 5 厘米）屏幕，可显示用户定制的 Muse 虚拟形象。 据《The Information》报道，Meta 计划为 Muse Charm 用户免费提供最长 12 个月的 Verizon 5G 数据服务，以便设备在没有 Wi-Fi 的情况下也能连接 Muse。 对于售价及相关产品信息，Meta 发言人泰勒 · 易（Tyler Yee）回应称，公司很高兴看到外界对其 AI 设备的关注，并将在不久后分享更多信息。 除 Muse Charm 外，Meta 还在研发智能手表。据《The Information》报道，Meta 已将智能手表的推出时间推迟至 2027 年，以便优先推进 Muse Charm 的上市工作。 此外，Meta 已于今年 10 月开源 Muse Gadgets 项目，提供 ESP32 设备 SDK 和 Linux SDK，允许开发者利用 ESP32 开发板或树莓派等硬件，自行制作能够连接 Muse AI 智能体的设备，并接入显示屏、按钮、传感器等外设。
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 20: The Information reported today that Meta's new AI hardware device Muse Charm will cost about $300 (about 2,008 yuan at current exchange rates) and will come with up to 12 months of 5G data service provided by Verizon. Muse Charm is a small AI device with a screen, first shown by Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg at the September Meta Connect conference. Zuckerberg said then that the device was planned to go on sale during the December holiday shopping season but did not announce a specific price. Meta plans to let users interact by voice directly with its Muse AI agent through this handheld device without opening a phone app. Zuckerberg introduced that Muse Charm integrates Muse's real-time voice interaction and avatar technology and has a fingerprint sensor. Users can touch the fingerprint sensor to start interaction and talk directly with the Muse AI agent without unlocking the phone or opening an app. The device also has an about 2-inch (about 5 cm) screen that can display a user-customized Muse avatar. According to The Information, Meta plans to provide Muse Charm users with free Verizon 5G data service for up to 12 months so the device can connect to Muse without Wi-Fi. Asked about the price and related product information, Meta spokesperson Tyler Yee responded that the company is glad to see interest in its AI devices and will share more information soon. Besides Muse Charm, Meta is also developing a smartwatch. The Information reported that Meta has delayed the smartwatch launch to 2027 to prioritize the Muse Charm launch. In addition, Meta open-sourced the Muse Gadgets project in October, providing an ESP32 device SDK and Linux SDK, allowing developers to use hardware such as ESP32 development boards or Raspberry Pi to build their own devices that can connect to the Muse AI agent, with support for displays, buttons, sensors and other peripherals.
items.why_zh: 推测：若定价与赠流量属实，Muse Charm 可能降低 AI 硬件始终联网的使用门槛；但消息来自报道，Meta 未确认售价与套餐细节。
items.why_en: Speculation: If the pricing and bundled data are accurate, Muse Charm could lower the barrier to always-connected AI hardware; but the report is not confirmed by Meta on price or plan details.

items.summary_en: IT Morning Brief, Nov 20, 2026 (Friday). Today's important tech news includes: 1) Anthropic completed the largest IPO ever, with a listing valuation of $1.5 trillion; its issue price was set at $83 per share (about 554.5 yuan at current exchange rates), above the expected range announced last week, and its fully diluted market value reached $1.5 trillion (about 10.02 trillion yuan). 2) Apple phones can now run Android apps: an Android virtual machine app is on the App Store and can be installed on iPhone and iPad; a software called Andarium is now on Apple's App Store, described as an Android virtual machine that supports running Android apps on iPhone and iPad, with an Android 17 system based on LineageOS included and running entirely locally on the device. 3) Starting at 279,900 yuan: BYD Fang Cheng Bao Tai 9 launched, positioned as a large six-seat boxy vehicle; the new car debuts the DMS super hybrid all-round platform, with WLTC pure electric range of 310 km and combined range of over 1,600 km, and is equipped with a 30-inch panoramic giant screen, a 50-inch AR-HUD and a 2+2+2 six-seat layout. 4) Tencent significantly cuts Yuanbao investment: not as successful as we expected; Tencent disclosed operating data for WeChat AI assistant Xiaowei, and Tencent President Liu Chiping also admitted that another AI assistant, Yuanbao, did not meet expectations. 5) A 1 cm ruler actually had 12 ticks: Central South University notified about an AI paper controversy at an affiliated hospital and confirmed academic misconduct; Central South University said it always maintains zero tolerance for academic misconduct and will further strengthen research conduct, improve supervision and verification systems, and resolutely maintain a clean academic ecosystem. 6) BYD releases DMS super hybrid: DM-i's energy consumption, DM-p's performance, DMO's off-road capability; the DMS platform integrates the DM-i (energy-saving), DM-p (performance) and DMO (off-road) technical routes, billed as born for all-round capability; it debuts rear-drive vector control technology, integrating differential, differential lock, electronic limited slip and wheel-end decoupling to achieve large and strong, large and agile, large and stable, large and economical. 7) Huawei's thinnest Mate straight-screen phone is coming; Mate90 Air slim flagship scheduled for Nov 24; as Huawei's thinnest Mate straight-screen flagship ever, Huawei Mate90 Air will officially appear at the HUAWEI Mate X8 and all-scenario new product launch. 8) The steering wheel can also fold! Fang Cheng Bao Tai 9 launches with BYD's folding smart cockpit, fully self-developed and the world's first mass-produced; at the BYD Fang Cheng Bao Tai 9 launch event on the evening of Nov 20, officials announced that the Tai 9 is the first to launch with BYD's folding smart cockpit, which BYD calls a major 2026 technological achievement that is fully self-developed and the world's first mass-produced. 9) JAC Motors registers Dijing trademark; reports say it is closely related to future cooperation among JAC, Huawei and Maserati; latest information from the Trademark Office of the China National Intellectual Property Administration shows that Anhui Jianghuai Automobile Group Co., Ltd. recently applied to register the Dijing trademark, and Shanghai Securities News reported that industry experts said the new Dijing trademark is closely related to future cooperation among JAC, Huawei and Maserati. 10) Jensen Huang's daughter appeared at an all-hands meeting and looked in good shape; Nvidia is to pay bonuses early; on the morning of Nov 18 local time, Nvidia held an all-hands meeting at its Santa Clara headquarters in California, conducted both offline and via Microsoft Teams live stream, lasting nearly an hour. 11) Huawei hopes Apple will adjust the iOS Bluetooth pairing mechanism to solve pairing compatibility between old and new versions; Huawei raised a request through the EU DMA channel, hoping Apple will allow control of the AccessorySetupKit framework by iOS version, balancing the native pairing experience of the new system with the traditional connection process for old devices. 12) Alibaba's net profit attributable to shareholders for H1 FY2027 was 75.072 billion yuan, up 17% year on year; Alibaba's H1 FY2027 total revenue was 540.472 billion yuan, up 9% year on year. 13) All wine-red: the new BYD Han real vehicle exposed; earlier this month, Lu Tian, general manager of BYD Dynasty Network Sales Division, announced that a model with high user demand would be launched at the November Guangzhou Auto Show; meanwhile, BYD's third-generation Tang 8-series large five-seat tech flagship SUV is being prepared for launch, and display cars have gradually arrived at stores. 14) Huawei HarmonyOS Xinghe Interconnect officially supports transferring iPhone calls; currently adapted to Mate 90 series and XT 2 Ultimate Design models; Huawei officially released an illustrated post on Nov 19 introducing HarmonyOS Xinghe...

items.title_zh: 苹果 macOS 27.3 Beta 2 公测版发布：扩展 Siri AI 能力，强化完全磁盘访问权限管理
items.title_en: Apple Releases macOS 27.3 Beta 2 Public Beta: Expands Siri AI and Strengthens Full Disk Access Management
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，苹果于当地时间 11 月 19 日向公测版用户推送了 iOS / iPadOS 27.3 和 macOS 27.3 Beta 2，以及 tvOS 27.3 和 watchOS 27.3 的 Beta 2。 据 9to5Mac 和 MacRumors 报道，此次更新延续了苹果在新一代操作系统中对 Siri AI、Safari 浏览器及系统隐私权限管理的调整。 macOS 27.3 Beta 2 公测版的版本号为 26C5047e ，与此前发布的开发者预览版 Beta 2 一致。此次更新的重点之一是新增针对完全磁盘访问权限（Full Disk Access）和自动化工具的隐私控制选项，同时扩大 Apple Intelligence 在中国市场的可用性。 在此前发布的 macOS 27.3 Beta 1 中，苹果已经加入 Safari 垂直标签页和自适应深色模式，并为 Mac 引入原生实时活动（Live Activities）支持。此外，系统还增加了 Quick Look 对 Markdown 文件的渲染支持，以及针对通过 iCloud 链接分享潜在有害内容的额外检查机制。 Siri AI 也是此次系统更新的重点。macOS 27.3 扩展了 Siri 在信息、音乐、日历、照片和提醒事项等苹果自有应用中的操作能力，同时支持管理文件和文件夹。苹果还为第三方开发者提供了新的开发工具，允许他们通过基于 Markdown 的指令构建更深入的 Siri AI 集成。 语言支持方面，Siri AI 此前已在 macOS 27.3 Beta 1 中新增对繁体中文、挪威语、土耳其语和越南语的支持。 苹果目前尚未公布 27.3 系统正式版的具体发布日期。MacRumors 预计，相关系统更新有望于 12 月正式推出。IT之家后续将保持关注。 相关阅读： 《 苹果 iPadOS / macOS 27.3 DP Beta 2 系统更新后，国行 iPad 和 Mac 新增 Apple 智能 》 《 如何在苹果 macOS 27.3 Beta 2 关闭菜单栏“蓝色药丸”提示 》 《 苹果 macOS 27.3 开发者预览版 Beta 2 发布：细化应用授权，让用户管理更透明 》
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 20: Apple on Nov 19 local time released iOS/iPadOS 27.3 and macOS 27.3 Beta 2, as well as tvOS 27.3 and watchOS 27.3 Beta 2, to public beta users. According to 9to5Mac and MacRumors, the update continues Apple's adjustments to Siri AI, the Safari browser and system privacy permission management in its new-generation operating systems. The macOS 27.3 Beta 2 public beta has build number 26C5047e, consistent with the previously released developer preview Beta 2. One focus of the update is new privacy control options for Full Disk Access and automation tools, while expanding the availability of Apple Intelligence in the Chinese market. In the previously released macOS 27.3 Beta 1, Apple had already added Safari vertical tabs and adaptive dark mode, and introduced native Live Activities support for Mac. The system also added Quick Look rendering support for Markdown files and additional checks for potentially harmful content shared via iCloud links. Siri AI is also a focus of this system update. macOS 27.3 expands Siri's operational capabilities in Apple's own apps such as Messages, Music, Calendar, Photos and Reminders, and supports managing files and folders. Apple also provided new developer tools for third-party developers, allowing them to build deeper Siri AI integration through Markdown-based instructions. On language support, Siri AI previously added support for Traditional Chinese, Norwegian, Turkish and Vietnamese in macOS 27.3 Beta 1. Apple has not yet announced a specific release date for the official version of the 27.3 systems. MacRumors expects the related system updates may be officially released in December. IT Home will keep following. items.title_zh: AI 模型大幅降低古籍数字化成本：识别 1000 页内容费用已不到 0.1 美元
items.title_en: AI models sharply cut historical text digitization costs: under $0.1 per 1,000 pages
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，借助免费开放的 AI 模型，从扫描版书籍和档案中提取文字的成本已经大幅下降。 Hugging Face 的丹尼尔 · 范斯特里恩（Daniel van Strien）对 8 款能够识别图像中文字的 AI 模型进行了对比测试。测试材料共计 850 页，包括旧版自然历史书籍、1771 年版《大英百科全书》，以及打字和印刷的历史档案文件。 所有模型均在同一款 GPU 上运行，即英伟达（Nvidia）RTX PRO 6000。这款显卡由范斯特里恩通过 Hugging Face 租用，费用为每小时 2.75 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 18.4 元人民币） 。 测试结果显示，在图像尺寸相同的情况下，2025 年 4 月发布的最早一款模型 RolmOCR，每识别 1000 页内容的成本约为 0.51 美元 （现汇率约合 3.4 元人民币） ；而 2026 年 10 月发布的最新模型 LightOnOCR-3-0.8B，成本已经降至不到 0.1 美元 （现汇率约合 0.67 元人民币） 。按照这一水平，识别 100 万页内容所需的 GPU 租赁费用约为 65 至 130 美元 （现汇率约合 434.3 至 868.5 元人民币） ，具体取决于原始材料的类型。 范斯特里恩指出，优化模型的运行方式所节省的成本，与更换更新一代模型带来的节省幅度相当，甚至可能更多。具体优化措施包括让页面处理任务分配得更加均衡、使用尺寸更小的扫描图像、更新软件，以及换用运行速度更快的 GPU。 在识别准确率方面，最新模型处理书籍页面时的表现至少不逊于最早的模型。不过，部分模型也存在明显问题，例如会在空白页面上凭空生成文字，或者反复输出相同内容。 扫描识别 1000 页内容的成本对比：最早的模型需要约 0.51 美元 （现汇率约合 3.4 元人民币） ，最新模型已降至不到 0.1 美元 （现汇率约合 0.67 元人民币） ，中间五款模型的成本则基本处于相近水平。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 19, the cost of extracting text from scanned books and archives has fallen sharply with free and open AI models. Daniel van Strien of Hugging Face compared eight AI models capable of recognizing text in images. The test material totaled 850 pages, including old natural history books, the 1771 edition of the Encyclopaedia Britannica, and typed and printed historical archive documents. All models ran on the same GPU, an Nvidia RTX PRO 6000, which van Strien rented through Hugging Face for $2.75 per hour (about 18.4 yuan). The results showed that with the same image size, the earliest model, RolmOCR, released in April 2025, cost about $0.51 (about 3.4 yuan) per 1,000 pages recognized, while the latest model, LightOnOCR-3-0.8B, released in October 2026, cut the cost to under $0.1 (about 0.67 yuan). At that level, GPU rental for recognizing 1 million pages would cost about $65 to $130 (about 434.3 to 868.5 yuan), depending on the type of source material. Van Strien noted that optimizing how the models run can save as much as, or possibly more than, switching to a newer model; specific measures include more balanced page-processing tasks, smaller scanned images, software updates, and faster GPUs. On accuracy, the latest model performed at least as well as the earliest model on book pages. However, some models had clear problems, such as generating text on blank pages or repeatedly outputting the same content. Cost comparison for scanning 1,000 pages: the earliest model cost about $0.51, the latest model has fallen to under $0.1, and the five models in between were at broadly similar cost levels.
items.why_zh: 若测试结果可推广，这可能显著降低古籍和档案大规模数字化的成本，但测试仅覆盖 850 页和特定 GPU，尚不能代表所有材料与部署环境。
items.why_en: If the test results generalize, this could significantly lower the cost of digitizing historical texts and archives at scale, but the test covered only 850 pages and a specific GPU, so it does not yet represent all materials and deployment settings.

items.title_zh: 国际货币基金组织总裁警告：AI 投资热情过高影响，金融市场或现进一步调整
items.title_en: IMF chief warns excessive AI investment enthusiasm may bring further market adjustments
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，国际货币基金组织（IMF）总裁克里斯塔利娜 · 格奥尔基耶娃（Kristalina Georgieva）表示，受人工智能投资热潮可能过度膨胀等因素影响，金融市场或许还会出现一定程度的调整。 格奥尔基耶娃周四在深圳接受彭博电视台记者史蒂芬 · 恩格尔（Stephen Engle）采访时表示，IMF 此前就预计市场会出现调整，因为投资者对 AI 的热情“实在过高”，而接下来可能还会有进一步调整。 她表示：“目前我们还没有看到大规模市场调整，但预计可能还会出现一些调整。”她认为，这将有助于市场回到更加可持续的状态。 IT之家注意到，市场对巨额 AI 投资能否带来相应回报的担忧，近期加剧了全球金融市场的波动。纳斯达克 100 指数本月以来已下跌超过 4%，正朝着 2008 年以来表现最差的 11 月迈进。 格奥尔基耶娃还谈到了 AI 产业中的所谓“循环融资”现象。这种模式通常是指英伟达等芯片制造商向客户提供资金，让客户购买自己的芯片产品。 她透露，目前这类循环融资的规模约为 1 万亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 6.68 万亿元人民币） ，其中约三分之二来自债务融资。 格奥尔基耶娃认为，单从规模来看，这一数字“还不算特别庞大”，但真正令人担忧的是其增长速度，以及融资结构正逐渐从股权融资转向债务融资。 她警告称：“这可能带来金融稳定风险。” 不过，她认为，通过提高相关交易的透明度，让市场充分了解实际情况，同时提醒企业注意自身是否正在进入风险更高的领域，可以在一定程度上控制这种风险。 格奥尔基耶娃还表示，IMF 目前采取了相对保守的估算，认为人工智能能够为全球经济增长贡献 0.5 个百分点。 她将 2026 年称为“人工智能首次对全球经济增长产生实质性影响的一年”。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 19, International Monetary Fund (IMF) Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said financial markets may see further adjustments, partly because the AI investment boom may be overheating. In an interview with Bloomberg TV's Stephen Engle in Shenzhen on Thursday, Georgieva said the IMF had expected market adjustments because investor enthusiasm for AI is "really too high," and there may be further adjustments. "We have not yet seen a large-scale market adjustment, but we expect there may be some adjustments," she said, adding that this would help the market return to a more sustainable state. IT之家 noted that concerns over whether huge AI investments will deliver corresponding returns have recently increased volatility in global financial markets. The Nasdaq 100 has fallen more than 4% this month and is heading for its worst November since 2008. Georgieva also discussed so-called "circular financing" in the AI industry, a model that usually refers to chipmakers such as Nvidia providing funds to customers so they can buy their chips. She said such circular financing currently totals about $1 trillion (about 6.68 trillion yuan), about two-thirds of which is debt-financed. She said that in scale alone the figure is "not particularly huge," but the real concern is its growth rate and the shift in financing structure from equity toward debt. She warned: "This could bring financial stability risks." However, she said such risks can be contained to some extent by improving transparency around related transactions, letting the market fully understand the situation, and reminding companies to watch whether they are entering riskier areas. Georgieva also said the IMF currently uses a relatively conservative estimate that AI can contribute 0.5 percentage points to global economic growth. She called 2026 "the first year AI will have a substantive impact on global economic growth."
items.why_zh: 若格奥尔基耶娃的警告成立，AI 相关融资尤其是债务融资的快速增长可能成为金融稳定风险，但这是预警而非已发生的危机。
items.why_en: If Georgieva's warning holds, the rapid growth of AI-related financing, especially debt financing, could become a financial stability risk, but this is a warning rather than an already materialized crisis.

items.title_zh: 育碧成立 Motherbrain 专注于游戏 AI，半年员工人数减少近 1100 人
items.title_en: Ubisoft Establishes Motherbrain to Focus on Game AI; Headcount Falls Nearly 1,100 in Half a Year
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，VideoGamesChronicle 今日报道称，育碧成立了一家专注于游戏 AI 技术的新子公司 Motherbrain，负责研发用于游戏玩法创新的 AI 技术，并为旗下游戏开发团队提供支持。 根据育碧 11 月 19 日公布的 2026-2027 财年上半年财报，公司确认 Motherbrain 已正式成为独立子公司，主要负责开发游戏领域的生成式 AI 技术，支持旗下各个游戏创作团队探索新的玩法体验。 育碧联合创始人兼首席执行官 Yves Guillemot 表示，Motherbrain 是公司首个可实际体验的生成式 AI 项目 Teammates 背后的开发团队。成立子公司后，该团队将专注于开发自有游戏技术，为创作者提供支持，并探索更加丰富、沉浸式和具有互动性的玩家体验。 根据育碧财报，Motherbrain 当前的研发方向包括全新的玩家体验、具备记忆能力的智能 NPC，以及能够管理大型系统化游戏世界的 AI 游戏主持人。该团队计划为育碧旗下各个创意工作室提供技术支持，同时也将服务于外部游戏开发者，并与部分技术企业建立合作关系。 Teammates 是育碧此前推出的实验性生成式 AI 游戏项目，于 2025 年底公开。该项目尝试让玩家通过语音与搭载 AI 的 NPC 进行交流，使游戏角色能够根据对话内容作出回应。Motherbrain 此次正式独立，意味着这一研发团队将继续围绕生成式 AI 与游戏玩法展开技术开发。 此次调整也是育碧新运营模式的一部分。公司从 2026 年 1 月开始推进组织架构调整，将旗下业务划分为多个 Creative Houses（创意工作室），分别负责不同类型的游戏及相关 IP。育碧在最新财报中表示，新运营模式现已全面落实，Motherbrain 则作为专门的 AI 技术子公司纳入新架构。 值得注意的是，Motherbrain 成立的消息公布前不久，育碧刚刚确认将在加拿大蒙特利尔和魁北克裁减 166 个工作岗位。公司财报还显示，截至 2026 年 9 月底的半财年内，集团员工人数减少近 1100 人。 IT之家注：育碧尚未明确 Motherbrain 开发的技术是否会以独立产品形式推出，还是主要整合进旗下其他游戏。公司表示，该团队将重点开发自有技术，为游戏创作者提供支持。 相关阅读： 《 育碧被曝开发〈彩虹六号：维加斯〉新作，项目代号“Spades” 》 《 消息称育碧计划在德国三家工作室合计减少约 100 个岗位 》 《 育碧计划关闭芬兰 RedLynx 工作室，新加坡工作室也面临大幅裁员 》 《 全球上线不到一年，育碧〈彩虹六号〉手游官宣明年 1 月停止运营 》
items.summary_en: IT Home, Nov 20: VideoGamesChronicle reported today that Ubisoft has established a new subsidiary focused on game AI technology, Motherbrain, responsible for developing AI technology for gameplay innovation and supporting its game development teams. According to Ubisoft's fiscal 2026-2027 first-half earnings report published on Nov 19, the company confirmed that Motherbrain has officially become an independent subsidiary, mainly responsible for developing generative AI technology in games and supporting its various game creation teams in exploring new gameplay experiences. Ubisoft co-founder and CEO Yves Guillemot said Motherbrain is the development team behind Teammates, the company's first actually playable generative AI project. After becoming a subsidiary, the team will focus on developing its own game technology, supporting creators and exploring richer, more immersive and interactive player experiences. According to Ubisoft's earnings report, Motherbrain's current R&D directions include new player experiences, intelligent NPCs with memory, and AI game masters capable of managing large systemic game worlds. The team plans to provide technical support to Ubisoft's creative studios, while also serving external game developers and establishing partnerships with some technology companies. Teammates is an experimental generative AI game project previously launched by Ubisoft and unveiled in late 2025. The project tries to let players communicate by voice with AI-powered NPCs so that game characters can respond based on conversation content. Motherbrain's formal independence means this R&D team will continue to develop technology around generative AI and gameplay. The adjustment is also part of Ubisoft's new operating model. The company began organizational restructuring in January 2026, dividing its business into multiple Creative Houses responsible for different types of games and related IP. Ubisoft said in its latest earnings report that the new operating model has now been fully implemented, and Motherbrain is included in the new structure as a dedicated AI technology subsidiary. Notably, shortly before the Motherbrain news was announced, Ubisoft had just confirmed it would cut 166 jobs in Montreal and Quebec, Canada. items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，VideoGamesChronicle 今日报道称，育碧成立了一家专注于游戏 AI 技术的新子公司 Motherbrain，负责研发用于游戏玩法创新的 AI 技术，并为旗下游戏开发团队提供支持。 根据育碧 11 月 19 日公布的 2026-2027 财年上半年财报，公司确认 Motherbrain 已正式成为独立子公司，主要负责开发游戏领域的生成式 AI 技术，支持旗下各个游戏创作团队探索新的玩法体验。 育碧联合创始人兼首席执行官 Yves Guillemot 表示，Motherbrain 是公司首个可实际体验的生成式 AI 项目 Teammates 背后的开发团队。成立子公司后，该团队将专注于开发自有游戏技术，为创作者提供支持，并探索更加丰富、沉浸式和具有互动性的玩家体验。 根据育碧财报，Motherbrain 当前的研发方向包括全新的玩家体验、具备记忆能力的智能 NPC，以及能够管理大型系统化游戏世界的 AI 游戏主持人。该团队计划为育碧旗下各个创意工作室提供技术支持，同时也将服务于外部游戏开发者，并与部分技术企业建立合作关系。 Teammates 是育碧此前推出的实验性生成式 AI 游戏项目，于 2025 年底公开。该项目尝试让玩家通过语音与搭载 AI 的 NPC 进行交流，使游戏角色能够根据对话内容作出回应。Motherbrain 此次正式独立，意味着这一研发团队将继续围绕生成式 AI 与游戏玩法展开技术开发。 此次调整也是育碧新运营模式的一部分。公司从 2026 年 1 月开始推进组织架构调整，将旗下业务划分为多个 Creative Houses（创意工作室），分别负责不同类型的游戏及相关 IP。育碧在最新财报中表示，新运营模式现已全面落实，Motherbrain 则作为专门的 AI 技术子公司纳入新架构。 值得注意的是，Motherbrain 成立的消息公布前不久，育碧刚刚确认将在加拿大蒙特利尔和魁北克裁减 166 个工作岗位。公司财报还显示，截至 2026 年 9 月底的半财年内，集团员工人数减少近 1100 人。 IT之家注：育碧尚未明确 Motherbrain 开发的技术是否会以独立产品形式推出，还是主要整合进旗下其他游戏。公司表示，该团队将重点开发自有技术，为游戏创作者提供支持。 相关阅读： 《 育碧被曝开发〈彩虹六号：维加斯〉新作，项目代号“Spades” 》 《 消息称育碧计划在德国三家工作室合计减少约 100 个岗位 》 《 育碧计划关闭芬兰 RedLynx 工作室，新加坡工作室也面临大幅裁员 》 《 全球上线不到一年，育碧〈彩虹六号〉手游官宣明年 1 月停止运营 》

items.title_zh: OpenAI 开放 GPT-Live-1.1 API：支持实时双向对话，智能体可边聊天边处理复杂任务
items.title_en: OpenAI opens GPT-Live-1.1 API with real-time full-duplex voice for agents
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，OpenAI 今日宣布向开发者开放 GPT-Live-1.1 API 语音模型，允许第三方开发者将其集成到自己的应用程序中，构建能够实时聆听、回应并执行复杂任务的 AI 语音智能体。 据 OpenAI 介绍，GPT-Live-1.1 是 GPT-Live-1 的升级版本，具备全双工语音交互能力，可以同时聆听和说话，不必等待用户完整说完一句话才开始处理。该模型能够识别用户说话过程中的停顿、打断和语速变化，并实时判断应该继续聆听还是作出回应。 IT之家注：GPT-Live-1.1 自 2026 年 10 月 15 日起已成为 ChatGPT Plus 及更高级别订阅用户的默认语音模型。此次 API 开放，则进一步将相关能力提供给第三方开发者。 在具体能力方面，OpenAI 表示，GPT-Live-1.1 改进了多语言语音处理、指令遵循能力和语音保真度，能够更可靠地处理字母、数字等需要精确识别的信息，减少语音交互过程中出现的理解偏差。 此外，该模型支持将需要更深入推理或工具调用的任务委托给开发者选择的后端模型。开发者既可以使用 OpenAI 的模型，也可以接入第三方模型。后端模型在处理复杂任务时，语音对话仍然可以继续进行，无需中断当前交互。 这意味着，开发者可以将实时语音交互与后端模型的推理、工具调用能力结合起来，让语音智能体在回答用户问题的同时，处理需要多步骤执行的复杂工作流。 根据 OpenAI 官方 API 文档，GPT-Live 系列采用全双工架构，能够直接处理输入和输出音频，减少传统语音系统中语音识别（STT）、大语言模型（LLM）和语音合成（TTS）串联所产生的延迟。 OpenAI 已提供 GPT-Live-1.1 API 相关技术文档及接入指南，开发者可以通过 OpenAI 开发者平台了解模型能力、配置方式和具体使用方法。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 20: OpenAI announced it is opening the GPT-Live-1.1 API voice model to developers, allowing third parties to integrate it into their apps and build AI voice agents that listen, respond and carry out complex tasks in real time. OpenAI says GPT-Live-1.1 is an upgraded version of GPT-Live-1 with full-duplex voice interaction: it can listen and speak at the same time without waiting for the user to finish a sentence. The model can recognize pauses, interruptions and changes in speaking speed, and decide in real time whether to keep listening or respond. IT之家 notes that since Oct 15, 2026, GPT-Live-1.1 has been the default voice model for ChatGPT Plus and higher-tier subscribers; the API opening extends the capability to third-party developers. OpenAI says the version improves multilingual voice processing, instruction following and voice fidelity, handling letters and numbers that need precise recognition more reliably and reducing misunderstandings in voice interaction. The model can delegate tasks requiring deeper reasoning or tool calls to a back-end model chosen by the developer, either OpenAI's or a third party's; voice conversation can continue while the back-end handles complex tasks, without interrupting the interaction. According to OpenAI's official API documentation, the GPT-Live series uses a full-duplex architecture that processes input and output audio directly, reducing the latency of chaining speech recognition (STT), a large language model (LLM) and speech synthesis (TTS) in traditional voice systems. OpenAI has provided technical documentation and integration guides.
items.why_zh: 推测：全双工语音 API 向第三方开放，可能降低实时语音智能体的开发门槛，但实际延迟与稳定性仍需开发者实测。
items.why_en: Speculation: opening a full-duplex voice API to third parties may lower the barrier to building real-time voice agents, though actual latency and reliability still need developer testing.

items.title_zh: 只改一处代码，谷歌 AI 智能体优化 Harness 后任务成功率提升 8 倍
items.title_en: Google study: self-improving agent harness lifts SWE-bench Lite success from 5% to 40%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，谷歌研究人员当地时间 11 月 17 日最新发表的研究论文《Harnesses That Improve Themselves》（《能够自我改进的 Harness》）显示，通过让 AI 智能体逐步修改自身运行框架，并对每次修改进行验证，可以显著提高软件工程任务的完成率。 在一项 SWE-bench Lite 测试中，采用模块化优化方案的智能体任务成功率从 5.0% 提升至 40.0%，达到原来的 8 倍，平均每项任务消耗约 4.67 万 Token。 其研究重点是 AI 智能体的 Harness。它并非底层 AI 模型本身，而是围绕模型构建的运行框架，负责管理上下文和记忆、控制多轮任务执行、调用外部工具，以及在任务结束前验证执行结果。 研究人员指出，不同模型在工具使用方式和任务执行过程中表现出的弱点可能存在明显差异。因此，为某个模型优化的 Harness，迁移到其他模型后可能出现任务停滞、Token 消耗过高或执行效果下降等问题。 为解决这一问题，研究人员提出了一套能够自我改进的 Harness 架构。与传统上通过修改提示词来约束智能体不同，该方案允许优化模型直接修改 Harness 的代码，并通过测试决定是否保留修改。 实验采用一套仅有 142 行代码的初始编程智能体 Harness，将其拆分为四个可编辑模块，分别负责上下文与状态管理、智能体控制、工具调用接口，以及验证与故障恢复。 每轮优化过程中，系统只允许修改其中一个模块。优化模型首先根据智能体执行记录识别问题并提出代码修改方案，随后通过验证集检查修改效果，同时受到 Token 使用上限约束。只有通过验证的修改才会被保留，未达到要求的方案则会被舍弃。 在核心测试中，研究人员使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 作为执行任务的基础模型，并在 40 道未参与优化的 SWE-bench Lite 软件工程任务上评估不同方案的表现。 结果显示，初始 Harness 的任务成功率为 5.0%，采用模块化修改和验证机制后，成功率提高至 40.0%，平均每项任务消耗约 4.67 万 Token。 作为对照，如果允许优化模型不受限制地整体重写 Harness，任务成功率可以达到 42.5%，略高于模块化方案，但平均每项任务需要消耗约 45.16 万 Token，是模块化方案的近 10 倍。 IT之家注意到，另一项实验则采用仅修改提示词规则文件的方式约束智能体，结果任务成功率反而从初始的 5.0% 降至 2.5%。 研究还考察了优化后的 Harness 迁移到其他模型时的表现。在不重新进行优化搜索的情况下，模块化方案迁移至 Gemini 4 Argon 后，任务成功率达到 37.5%，而整体重写方案为 30.0%。 研究人员认为，Harness 的自我改进不应仅依赖提示词，而应将重要约束落实到实际代码中。例如，通过自动测试检查任务执行结果、识别重复失败和阻止未经验证的任务结束，可以让智能体更可靠地完成复杂任务。 论文同时指出，允许智能体修改自身运行代码也会带来新的风险，包括提示词内容不断膨胀、针对基准测试进行过度优化，以及篡改评估程序等。因此，代码修改需要受到验证机制和权限边界约束。 需要注意的是，这项研究的实验主要围绕特定模型和 SWE-bench Lite 软件工程任务展开，核心测试集仅包含 40 道未参与优化的任务，尚不足以证明该方法在所有模型和智能体应用场景中都能取得相同效果。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 20: a Google research paper published Nov 17, titled Harnesses That Improve Themselves, shows that letting an AI agent gradually modify its own runtime framework and validating each change can significantly raise completion rates on software engineering tasks. On SWE-bench Lite, an agent using a modular optimization scheme raised task success from 5.0% to 40.0% — 8x — at about 46,700 tokens per task. The focus is the agent harness: not the underlying AI model but the runtime framework built around it, which manages context and memory, controls multi-turn task execution, calls external tools and verifies results before a task ends. The researchers note that different models can show clearly different weaknesses in tool use and task execution, so a harness optimized for one model may stall, consume too many tokens or perform worse after being moved to another. To address this, they propose a self-improving harness architecture: unlike traditional prompt edits used to constrain agents, the scheme lets the optimizing model directly edit the harness code, with tests deciding whether a change is kept. The experiment started from a 142-line coding-agent harness split into four editable modules covering context and state management, agent control, tool-calling interfaces, and verification and failure recovery. Each optimization round allows edits to only one module; the optimizing model first identifies problems from execution logs and proposes code changes, then checks them on a validation set under a token cap, keeping only changes that pass. In the core test, Gemini 3.8 Flash served as the base model for executing tasks, evaluated on 40 SWE-bench Lite tasks not used in optimization: success rose from 5.0% with the initial harness to 40.0% with modular editing and verification, at about 46,700 tokens per task. As a control, letting the optimizer rewrite the entire harness without restriction reached 42.5%, slightly higher, but required about 451,600 tokens per task, nearly 10x. Another experiment that only edited prompt/rule files lowered success from 5.0% to 2.5%. On transfer without a new optimization search, the modular scheme reached 37.5% on Gemini 4 Argon versus 30.0% for full rewriting. The researchers argue that harness self-improvement should not rely on prompts alone but should encode key constraints in actual code, for example automated tests checking task results, detecting repeated failures and blocking unverified task completion. The paper also notes that letting agents modify their own runtime code creates new risks, including prompt bloat, over-optimization for benchmarks and tampering with evaluation programs, so code edits need verification mechanisms and permission boundaries. The research mainly covers specific models and SWE-bench Lite tasks, with a core test set of only 40 tasks not used in optimization, which is not enough to show the method works equally across all models and agent applications.
items.why_zh: 推测：该结果提示智能体表现可能很大程度取决于运行框架而非仅靠提示词，但 40 道任务的测试规模限制了结论外推。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，谷歌研究人员当地时间 11 月 17 日最新发表的研究论文《Harnesses That Improve Themselves》（《能够自我改进的 Harness》）显示，通过让 AI 智能体逐步修改自身运行框架，并对每次修改进行验证，可以显著提高软件工程任务的完成率。 在一项 SWE-bench Lite 测试中，采用模块化优化方案的智能体任务成功率从 5.0% 提升至 40.0%，达到原来的 8 倍，平均每项任务消耗约 4.67 万 Token。 其研究重点是 AI 智能体的 Harness。它并非底层 AI 模型本身，而是围绕模型构建的运行框架，负责管理上下文和记忆、控制多轮任务执行、调用外部工具，以及在任务结束前验证执行结果。 研究人员指出，不同模型在工具使用方式和任务执行过程中表现出的弱点可能存在明显差异。因此，为某个模型优化的 Harness，迁移到其他模型后可能出现任务停滞、Token 消耗过高或执行效果下降等问题。 为解决这一问题，研究人员提出了一套能够自我改进的 Harness 架构。与传统上通过修改提示词来约束智能体不同，该方案允许优化模型直接修改 Harness 的代码，并通过测试决定是否保留修改。 实验采用一套仅有 142 行代码的初始编程智能体 Harness，将其拆分为四个可编辑模块，分别负责上下文与状态管理、智能体控制、工具调用接口，以及验证与故障恢复。 每轮优化过程中，系统只允许修改其中一个模块。优化模型首先根据智能体执行记录识别问题并提出代码修改方案，随后通过验证集检查修改效果，同时受到 Token 使用上限约束。只有通过验证的修改才会被保留，未达到要求的方案则会被舍弃。 在核心测试中，研究人员使用 Gemini 3.8 Flash 作为执行任务的基础模型，并在 40 道未参与优化的 SWE-bench Lite 软件工程任务上评估不同方案的表现。 结果显示，初始 Harness 的任务成功率为 5.0%，采用模块化修改和验证机制后，成功率提高至 40.0%，平均每项任务消耗约 4.67 万 Token。 作为对照，如果允许优化模型不受限制地整体重写 Harness，任务成功率可以达到 42.5%，略高于模块化方案，但平均每项任务需要消耗约 45.16 万 Token，是模块化方案的近 10 倍。 IT之家注意到，另一项实验则采用仅修改提示词规则文件的方式约束智能体，结果任务成功率反而从初始的 5.0% 降至 2.5%。 研究还考察了优化后的 Harness 迁移到其他模型时的表现。在不重新进行优化搜索的情况下，模块化方案迁移至 Gemini 4 Argon 后，任务成功率达到 37.5%，而整体重写方案为 30.0%。 研究人员认为，Harness 的自我改进不应仅依赖提示词，而应将重要约束落实到实际代码中。例如，通过自动测试检查任务执行结果、识别重复失败和阻止未经验证的任务结束，可以让智能体更可靠地完成复杂任务。 论文同时指出，允许智能体修改自身运行代码也会带来新的风险，包括提示词内容不断膨胀、针对基准测试进行过度优化，以及篡改评估程序等。因此，代码修改需要受到验证机制和权限边界约束。 需要注意的是，这项研究的实验主要围绕特定模型和 SWE-bench Lite 软件工程任务展开，核心测试集仅包含 40 道未参与优化的任务，尚不足以证明该方法在所有模型和智能体应用场景中都能取得相同效果。

items.title_en: China Commerce Ministry: smart glasses sales on key platforms doubled in Jan–Oct, embodied AI robots up 25.2%
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 20 日消息，11 月 19 日， 商务部消费促进司负责人谈 2026 年 1-10 月我国消费市场情况。今年以来，我国消费市场规模稳步扩大，呈现商品消费稳、服务消费旺、新型消费热的特点。1-10 月，社会消费商品和服务零售总额同比（下同）增长 2.5%。 IT之家从公告获悉，在消费品以旧换新政策强有力的带动下，绿色、智能消费持续增长。1-10 月，限额以上单位通讯器材（含手机）、文化办公用品（含电脑、平板）零售额分别增长 16.5%、6.0%。商务部商务大数据显示， 重点平台智能眼镜销售额增长 1 倍 ，外骨骼助力器销售额增长 44.4%，具身智能机器人销售额增长 25.2%。据汽车流通协会数据， 10 月新能源乘用车零售渗透率达 67.5% 。 1-10 月，社会消费品零售总额增长 1.0%，除汽车以外的消费品零售额增长 2.8%。其中，限额以上单位粮油食品、化妆品、饮料零售额分别增长 6.1%、5.6%、4.9%。网上商品零售额中，吃、穿类商品分别增长 15.3%、1.8%。 1-10 月，服务零售额增长 4.9%，增速高于商品零售额 4.0 个百分点。消费场景不断丰富拓展，节假日旅游、休闲娱乐等服务消费热度不减，旅游咨询租赁服务类、文体休闲服务类零售额均明显快于服务零售额增长。 1-10 月，包含镇区和乡村的县乡消费品零售额增长 1.9%，增速明显快于城区水平。其中乡村消费品零售额增长 2.2%，增速连续 15 个月快于城镇。
items.summary_en: IT之家, Nov 20: on Nov 19, an official of the Ministry of Commerce's Department of Consumer Promotion discussed China's consumer market in January–October 2026, saying the market has steadily expanded this year with stable goods consumption, strong services consumption and hot new-type consumption. In Jan–Oct, total retail sales of consumer goods and services rose 2.5% year on year. According to the announcement, green and smart consumption kept growing under the consumer goods trade-in policy: retail sales of communication equipment (including phones) and cultural and office supplies (including computers and tablets) by units above designated size rose 16.5% and 6.0%, respectively. Ministry of Commerce big data shows sales on key platforms grew 100% for smart glasses, 44.4% for exoskeleton assist devices and 25.2% for embodied AI robots. According to China Automobile Dealers Association data, the retail penetration rate of new-energy passenger cars reached 67.5% in October. In Jan–Oct, total retail sales of consumer goods rose 1.0%, and retail sales excluding automobiles rose 2.8%; retail sales by units above designated size rose 6.1% for grain, oil and food, 5.6% for cosmetics and 4.9% for beverages. Among online goods sales, food and clothing rose 15.3% and 1.8%, respectively. In Jan–Oct, services retail sales rose 4.9%, 4.0 percentage points faster than goods retail; retail sales of travel consulting and rental services and of cultural, sports and leisure services grew notably faster than overall services retail. In Jan–Oct, retail sales in counties and townships, including towns and villages, rose 1.9%, faster than urban areas; rural retail sales rose 2.2%, faster than urban areas for the 15th consecutive month.
items.why_zh: 推测：官方数据反映智能眼镜、具身智能机器人等新品类消费升温，但披露的是重点平台销售额增速，未给出绝对规模。
items.why_en: Speculation: the official figures point to rising consumer interest in new categories such as smart glasses and embodied AI robots, but they are sales growth rates on key platforms, not absolute market size.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 完成史上最大规模 IPO，上市估值达 1.5 万亿美元
items.title_en: Anthropic completes the largest IPO in history, with a listing valuation of $1.5 trillion
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，北京时间今天（19 日）深夜，AI 初创企业 Anthropic 正式登陆美股，以 813 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 5,431.47 亿元人民币） 的募资额创下 IPO 历史纪录。 公司 CEO 达里奥 · 阿莫代伊在纳斯达克敲响开市钟。“今天的上市让公司的财务基础更加稳固，也让我们更加坚定了 做正确事情 的决心。” Anthropic 的发行价定为 每股 83 美元 （现汇率约合 554.5 元人民币） ，高于上周公布的预期区间，完全稀释后市值达到 1.5 万亿美元 （现汇率约合 10.02 万亿元人民币） 。 彭博社和路透社报道称，预计正式开盘后，Anthropic 股价还将上涨约 20%，达到每股 100 美元 （现汇率约合 668.1 元人民币） 左右。 当地时间 18 日，Anthropic 还宣布向承销商出售 9.8 亿股股票，扩大后的发行规模使募资总额达到 813 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5,431.47 亿元人民币） ，打破 SpaceX 今年 6 月 IPO 募资 750 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5,010.58 亿元人民币） 的纪录。 Anthropic 成立于 2021 年，仅用了五年左右的时间，便有望跻身全球市值最高的上市公司之列。 Anthropic 是 首家上市的前沿 AI 研发机构 ，其股价表现将成为观察数万亿美元 AI 投资热潮的重要风向标。华尔街投资者和全球科技行业都在密切关注公司上市后的表现。 Anthropic 于 10 月底提交的招股书显示，公司成立以来每年营收都呈爆发式增长，部分年份增幅甚至超过 1000%。2026 年上半年，Anthropic 营收达到 162 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,082.29 亿元人民币） ，远高于 2025 年全年的 46 亿美元 （现汇率约合 307.32 亿元人民币） 。 但 Anthropic 也付出了巨大的财务代价。公司 2026 年上半年亏损 800 亿美元 （现汇率约合 5,344.62 亿元人民币） ，主要源于一笔一次性费用，前九个月累计亏损进一步扩大至 1,040 亿美元 （现汇率约合 6,948.01 亿元人民币） 。 随着 Anthropic 不断扩大算力资源投入，成本预计还会大幅攀升。算力主要由通常部署在数据中心的半导体芯片提供，是运行生成式 AI 的基础，也是 Anthropic 最大的支出项目 。2026 年前九个月，公司在算力方面花费约 188 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,255.99 亿元人民币） 。 Anthropic 高管在招股书中写道：“开发前沿 AI 模型需要投入大量算力、资金和人力，开展可能持续数周甚至数月的大规模训练，每次训练的费用可能高达数百万美元。” Anthropic 还在招股文件中详细披露了 旗下 AI 模型可能给人类带来的各种风险 ，包括被用于开发生物武器，或加剧世界各地的压迫行为。此前，员工曾担忧部分企业以不负责任的方式开发先进 AI 模型，阿莫代伊随后呼吁放缓最先进 AI 模型的研发速度。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on November 19 that late that night Beijing time, AI startup Anthropic officially listed on US stock markets, raising $81.3 billion and setting an IPO fundraising record. CEO Dario Amodei rang the Nasdaq opening bell, saying the listing made the company's financial foundation more solid and strengthened its determination to 'do the right thing.' The offering was priced at $83 per share, above the expected range announced the previous week, giving a fully diluted valuation of $1.5 trillion. Bloomberg and Reuters reported that the stock was expected to rise about 20% after official trading began, to around $100 per share. On local time November 18, Anthropic also announced the sale of 980 million shares to underwriters; the expanded offering brought total fundraising to $81.3 billion, breaking SpaceX's record of $75 billion from its June IPO this year. Founded in 2021, Anthropic could enter the ranks of the world's most valuable listed companies in about five years, and is the first listed frontier AI research organization; its stock performance will be an important barometer for the multi-trillion-dollar AI investment boom. Its prospectus filed at the end of October showed explosive revenue growth every year since founding, with some years exceeding 1,000%; revenue in the first half of 2026 reached $16.2 billion, far above full-year 2025 revenue of $4.6 billion. But Anthropic also paid a huge financial price: it lost $80 billion in the first half of 2026, mainly due to a one-time charge, and its cumulative loss in the first nine months widened to $104 billion. As Anthropic expands compute investment, costs are expected to rise sharply; in the first nine months of 2026 it spent about $18.8 billion on compute. Executives wrote in the prospectus that developing frontier AI models requires large amounts of compute, capital and talent for massive training that may last weeks or months, with each training run potentially costing millions of dollars. The filing also detailed risks its AI models may pose to humanity, including use in developing biological weapons or exacerbating oppression; previously, employees worried that some companies were developing advanced AI irresponsibly, and Amodei later called for slowing the development of the most advanced AI models.

items.why_en: As reported, this is the first listed frontier AI research organization, and its stock performance may become a barometer for the AI investment boom (speculation).

items.title_zh: ChatGPT 上线实时听写，可在你说话时转写
items.title_en: ChatGPT can transcribe as you speak now with Live Dictation
items.summary_zh: ChatGPT 现在通过 Live Dictation 功能更快地从麦克风接收音频提示：它会在你说话时进行转写，而不是等到录音结束。该功能正在全球范围内向所有 ChatGPT 套餐的网页版、桌面应用以及 iOS 和 Android 应用推出。使用 ChatGPT 听写时，你可以点击音频波形，查看 AI 生成的实时文字转写，并在完成后在提示框中编辑。ChatGPT 的听写正变得更快、更可靠；借助 Live Dictation，你的语音会在说话过程中变成文字，从而减少等待消息转写完成的时间。
items.summary_en: ChatGPT can receive audio prompts from your microphone faster now with a Live Dictation feature that transcribes as you speak, rather than waiting until you finish recording. It's rolling out now globally on all ChatGPT plans on the web, desktop app, and iOS and Android apps. While using dictation in ChatGPT, you can tap or click the audio waveform to show the live text transcript the AI is generating, then edit it in the prompt box when you're done. Dictation in ChatGPT is getting faster and more reliable. With Live Dictation, your speech turns into text as you talk, so you spend less time waiting for your message to finish transcribing. … Read the full story at The Verge.
items.why_zh: 实时转写可能减少语音输入等待时间，并改变用户与 ChatGPT 的交互方式（推测）。
items.why_en: Live transcription may reduce waiting time for voice input and change how users interact with ChatGPT (speculation).

items.title_zh: AI 炒作指数：AI 无处不在
items.title_en: The AI Hype Index: AI is everywhere
items.summary_zh: 像难缠的皮疹一样，AI 似乎无处不在。谷歌把 AI Overviews 强塞给用户，尽管这会让公司损失数十亿美元广告收入。离开公寓，你可能会遇到两个人抬着一台 AI 驱动的人形机器人上楼去打扫某人的房间。去超市，你也许会因为 AI 辅助的网络攻击导致融化的冰淇淋在地上凝成一摊而滑倒。你去看电影，看到安德鲁·加菲尔德以令人不适的强度饰演萨姆·奥尔特曼；回家后发现埃隆·马斯克发布了一个 Grok 版的《奥德赛》。你想看它，但它感觉像一则漫长且无法跳过的手机广告。某种程度上，现在整个世界都有点像这样：像现代奥德修斯，你被诅咒在充斥 AI 的水域漫游，与机器神和怪物搏斗，试图找到回某个像家的地方的路。
items.summary_en: Like a nasty rash, AI seems to spread everywhere. Google crams AI Overviews down your throat even though it costs the company billions of dollars in lost ad revenue. Leave your apartment, and you might pass two people heaving an AI-powered humanoid robot up the stairs to clean someone’s rooms. Go to the supermarket, and perhaps you’ll slip on a pool of melted ice cream congealing on the floor thanks to an AI-assisted cyberattack . You go to the movies and see Sam Altman being played with nauseating intensity by Andrew Garfield, and go back home to find that Elon Musk has released a Grok-fied version of The Odyssey . You try to watch it, but it feels like a long, unskippable mobile ad. In a way, the whole world kind of feels that way now: Like a modern Odysseus, you are cursed to roam AI-infested waters, dueling with machine gods and monsters, trying to find your way back to somewhere that feels like home.
items.why_zh: 这是一篇讽刺性评论，呈现 AI 渗透日常生活的观感，而非可验证数据或新闻事实（推测/评论）。
items.why_en: This is a satirical commentary on the feeling of AI's pervasiveness rather than verifiable data or news (commentary/speculation).

items.title_zh: 欧盟委员会证实遭到 AI 驱动的网络攻击，事态规模暂难判断
items.title_en: European Commission confirms AI-driven cyberattack, scale still unclear
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，据路透社报道，当地时间 19 日，欧盟委员会证实遭受了利用 AI 工具进行的网络攻击。有关此事的调查尚未结束，事态规模暂难判断。 发言人托马斯 · 雷尼耶在记者会上说：“我可以确认，我们近期发现了一起网络攻击，并采取了必要的应对措施。为防止事态扩大和避免进一步风险， 我们暂时下线了几个应用程序，大部分后来恢复了运行 。调查还在继续，我们会根据陆续查明的情况采取必要措施。这场网络攻击是用 AI 生成的。” 这起攻击是 在 10 月 22 日发现的 ，尚无证据显示数据泄露波及委员会全体工作人员。至于怀疑谁发动了攻击，雷尼耶拒绝透露，也没有听说事后有人索要赎金。 这是近期又一起引发广泛关注的网络攻击。据IT之家了解，10 月，法国数百家超市的商用冷藏柜和冷冻柜因黑客攻击停运。此前，驶往美国的船只、美国的水处理厂和洛杉矶的公共交通系统也分别在 8 月、7 月和 3 月因遭到黑客攻击而中断运行。 此外， 全美范围的航班一度暂停起飞数小时 ，银行和微软的应用程序也出现无法使用的情况。技术专家认为，这些中断是紧急修补新发现的软件漏洞所致。 据 Politico 今天早些时候报道，欧盟委员会遇袭后，大量个人数据存在泄露风险。服务中断持续 10 天，其间有多个系统下线，包括处理工资单和工时管理的人事系统，以及医疗费用报销系统。 Politico 还报道说，欧盟委员会召集内部最高级别的危机管理机构紧急开会，讨论这些网络安全事件。负责科技事务的欧盟委员亨娜 · 维尔库宁周三向其他委员通报了情况。
items.summary_en: IT Home reported on November 19 that, according to Reuters, the European Commission confirmed on local time November 19 that it had suffered a cyberattack using AI tools. The investigation is not over and the scale is still hard to determine. Spokesperson Thomas Regnier said at a press conference: 'I can confirm that we recently detected a cyberattack and took the necessary response measures. To prevent the situation from expanding and avoid further risks, we temporarily took several applications offline, most of which later resumed operation. The investigation continues, and we will take necessary measures based on what is gradually established. This cyberattack was generated using AI.' The attack was discovered on October 22, and there is no evidence yet that a data breach affected all Commission staff. Regnier declined to say who was suspected, and he had not heard of any ransom demand afterward. This is another recently widely noticed cyberattack. According to IT Home, in October, commercial refrigerators and freezers at hundreds of French supermarkets stopped operating due to a hack. Previously, ships bound for the US, US water treatment plants, and Los Angeles public transit were disrupted by hacks in August, July, and March, respectively. In addition, US-wide flights were once suspended for several hours, and banking and Microsoft applications also became unavailable. Technology experts believe these disruptions were caused by emergency patching of newly discovered software vulnerabilities. Politico reported earlier today that after the Commission attack, a large amount of personal data was at risk of leakage. items.title_zh: Meta 员工爆料：Muse 智能体可能擅自读取加密消息与银行账户余额
items.title_en: Meta employees say Muse agent may have accessed encrypted messages and bank balances without permission
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，多名用户、安全研究员最近发现，Meta 旗下 Muse 智能体可能会泄露隐私。 例如，科技领域记者 Jason Aten 曾在 9 月发现，尽管自己明确拒绝了授权，他电脑里的 Muse 仍然访问了 iMessage。安全研究员 Patrick Wardle 则发现 Muse 存在零日漏洞，攻击者可用其劫持用户语音输入的提示词，并将这些内容转发出来。 据路透社昨天报道，多名 Meta 员工发现 Muse 存在更严重的隐私泄露问题。其中一名员工在个人手机使用 Muse 时，发现智能体主动提醒他回复姐姐在 Signal 发送的消息。作为参考，Signal 是一款主打端到端加密的聊天应用。 这名员工表示， 他绝对没有授权 Muse 读取 Signal 。据悉，Muse 似乎是通过推送通知获取到了这些消息。随后 AI Now 研究所复现了这个问题。 另一名 Meta 员工则表示，他的 Muse 在平时发送的天气消息时，随机插入了一条额外信息：“顺便说一下，这里有两条银行账户更新信息：你的 Capital One 账户余额为 2,722.58 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 18,189 元人民币） ，嘉信理财账户余额为 5,899.57 美元 （现汇率约合 39,414 元人民币） 。” 该员工表示， 他从未向 Muse 授权过读取银行账户信息 ，也没有和 Muse 讨论过任何银行话题。 Meta 对此回应称，这些都是孤立事件，并暗示上述银行账户余额信息可能是 AI 幻觉，并非真实发生的数据泄露。
items.summary_en: According to IT之家 on November 19, multiple users and security researchers have found that Meta's Muse agent may leak private data. Tech journalist Jason Aten said that despite explicitly refusing authorization, Muse on his computer still accessed iMessage; security researcher Patrick Wardle found a zero-day vulnerability in Muse that attackers could use to hijack prompts from users' voice input and forward them. Reuters reported yesterday that multiple Meta employees found more serious privacy leaks in Muse. One employee said that while using Muse on a personal phone, the agent proactively reminded him to reply to a message his sister sent on Signal, an end-to-end encrypted chat app. The employee said he absolutely did not authorize Muse to read Signal; Muse appeared to obtain the messages through push notifications. The AI Now Institute subsequently reproduced the issue. Another Meta employee said that while Muse was normally sending weather messages, it randomly inserted an extra message: "By the way, here are two bank account updates: your Capital One account balance is $2,722.58 (about 18,189 yuan at current exchange rates) and your Charles Schwab account balance is $5,899.57 (about 39,414 yuan at current exchange rates)." The employee said he had never authorized Muse to read bank account information and had never discussed any banking topics with Muse. Meta responded that these were isolated incidents and suggested the bank balance information may be an AI hallucination rather than a real data leak.
items.why_zh: 若这些说法属实，AI 助手可能在用户未授权时接触端到端加密消息和金融信息；但 Meta 称是孤立事件并暗示可能为幻觉，相关说法尚待独立验证。
items.why_en: If the claims are accurate, an AI assistant could access end-to-end encrypted messages and financial information without user authorization; however, Meta calls them isolated incidents and suggests possible hallucination, so the claims await independent verification.

items.title_zh: 特斯拉 Cybercab 自动驾驶订阅费高昂，用车四年后总成本将超 Model 3
items.title_en: Tesla Cybercab’s High Self-Driving Subscription Pushes Four-Year Total Cost Above Model 3
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，特斯拉 Cybercab 看起来很便宜，但使用起来可能就不是那么回事了。 这款取消方向盘设计的 Robotaxi 无人驾驶出租车起售价为 29,990 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） ，是特斯拉首款官方标价低于 3 万美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） 的车型。不过，想要启用自动驾驶功能，车主还必须订阅每月 299 美元 （现汇率约合 1,998 元人民币） 的 Autonomy 订阅服务。 按照特斯拉目前公布的价格计算，这笔强制订阅费用会让 Cybercab 的长期持有成本迅速攀升。以基础版 Model 3 为例，如果选择每月 99 美元 （现汇率约合 661.4 元人民币） 的 FSD（监督版）订阅，持有 Cybercab 到第 45 个月时，前者的总成本就会反超后者。 到了持有第五年，Cybercab 的总成本将达到 47,631 美元 （现汇率约合 31.8 万元人民币） ，比 Model 3 高出 3,160 美元 （现汇率约合 21,111 元人民币） ，甚至比搭载特斯拉月度 FSD 订阅服务、尺寸更大的 Model Y 还要贵 160 美元 （现汇率约合 1,069 元人民币） 。 特斯拉 CEO 埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）也承认，Cybercab 目前的定价存在问题。 在 X 平台上，马斯克回应了科技评测博主马奎斯 · 布朗利（Marques Brownlee，网名 MKBHD）的评论，表示 Cybercab 每月 299 美元 （现汇率约合 1,998 元人民币） 的订阅费“太高了”，应该降至 115 美元 （现汇率约合 768.3 元人民币） 左右。 多年来，马斯克一直承诺推出价格更低的特斯拉汽车，让更多美国消费者有机会购买电动汽车。路透社 2024 年曾报道称，特斯拉取消了一款原计划售价 2.5 万美元 （现汇率约合 16.7 万元人民币） 、配备人工驾驶功能的新车型项目，转而将研发重点放在自动驾驶技术上。 与此同时，美国市场上售价低于 3 万美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） 的电动汽车仍然不多。消费者目前可以选择起售价 27,600 美元 （现汇率约合 18.4 万元人民币） 的雪佛兰 Bolt、售价 29,990 美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） 的日产 Leaf，或者等待即将推出、售价 24,950 美元 （现汇率约合 16.7 万元人民币） 的 Slate 电动皮卡。 根据 Cox Automotive 的数据，2026 年 8 月，美国新款电动汽车的平均成交价为 54,813 美元 （现汇率约合 36.6 万元人民币） ，仍比同级别燃油车高出 9.4%。 晨星公司（Morningstar）股票分析师塞思 · 戈尔茨坦（Seth Goldstein）认为，如果特斯拉向车主提供的自动驾驶系统比 FSD（监督版）更加先进，那么 Cybercab 收取更高的月度订阅费也有一定合理性。 他向 Business Insider 表示：“更高的 FSD 价格也有其合理性，因为它很可能采用最新版本，领先于面向普通消费者的版本，同时还要用于运营 Robotaxi 业务。”
items.summary_en: Tesla’s Cybercab starts at $29,990, making it Tesla’s first model officially priced below $30,000, but enabling autonomous driving requires a $299-per-month Autonomy subscription. Based on currently announced prices, by the 45th month the Cybercab’s total ownership cost would exceed that of a base Model 3 (with the latter subscribing to FSD at $99 per month); by the fifth year, the Cybercab’s total cost would reach $47,631, $3,160 more than the Model 3 and $160 more than the larger Model Y with Tesla’s monthly FSD subscription. Musk responded to tech reviewer MKBHD on X that the $299 monthly fee is 'too high' and should be around $115. The report also notes Reuters reported in 2024 that Tesla canceled a planned $25,000 new model with manual driving and shifted focus to autonomous driving; U.S. EVs below $30,000 remain limited; Cox Automotive data shows the average transaction price for new U.S. EVs in August 2026 was $54,813; Morningstar analyst Seth Goldstein said a higher monthly fee could be reasonable if Tesla provides a more advanced autonomous-driving system than FSD (Supervised).
items.why_zh: 推测：高昂的强制订阅费可能削弱 Cybercab 的低价吸引力，并影响其 Robotaxi 模式的商业可行性。

items.source_summary: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，特斯拉 Cybercab 看起来很便宜，但使用起来可能就不是那么回事了。 这款取消方向盘设计的 Robotaxi 无人驾驶出租车起售价为 29,990 美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） ，是特斯拉首款官方标价低于 3 万美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） 的车型。不过，想要启用自动驾驶功能，车主还必须订阅每月 299 美元 （现汇率约合 1,998 元人民币） 的 Autonomy 订阅服务。 按照特斯拉目前公布的价格计算，这笔强制订阅费用会让 Cybercab 的长期持有成本迅速攀升。以基础版 Model 3 为例，如果选择每月 99 美元 （现汇率约合 661.4 元人民币） 的 FSD（监督版）订阅，持有 Cybercab 到第 45 个月时，前者的总成本就会反超后者。 到了持有第五年，Cybercab 的总成本将达到 47,631 美元 （现汇率约合 31.8 万元人民币） ，比 Model 3 高出 3,160 美元 （现汇率约合 21,111 元人民币） ，甚至比搭载特斯拉月度 FSD 订阅服务、尺寸更大的 Model Y 还要贵 160 美元 （现汇率约合 1,069 元人民币） 。 特斯拉 CEO 埃隆 · 马斯克（Elon Musk）也承认，Cybercab 目前的定价存在问题。 在 X 平台上，马斯克回应了科技评测博主马奎斯 · 布朗利（Marques Brownlee，网名 MKBHD）的评论，表示 Cybercab 每月 299 美元 （现汇率约合 1,998 元人民币） 的订阅费“太高了”，应该降至 115 美元 （现汇率约合 768.3 元人民币） 左右。 多年来，马斯克一直承诺推出价格更低的特斯拉汽车，让更多美国消费者有机会购买电动汽车。路透社 2024 年曾报道称，特斯拉取消了一款原计划售价 2.5 万美元 （现汇率约合 16.7 万元人民币） 、配备人工驾驶功能的新车型项目，转而将研发重点放在自动驾驶技术上。 与此同时，美国市场上售价低于 3 万美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） 的电动汽车仍然不多。消费者目前可以选择起售价 27,600 美元 （现汇率约合 18.4 万元人民币） 的雪佛兰 Bolt、售价 29,990 美元 （现汇率约合 20 万元人民币） 的日产 Leaf，或者等待即将推出、售价 24,950 美元 （现汇率约合 16.7 万元人民币） 的 Slate 电动皮卡。 根据 Cox Automotive 的数据，2026 年 8 月，美国新款电动汽车的平均成交价为 54,813 美元 （现汇率约合 36.6 万元人民币） ，仍比同级别燃油车高出 9.4%。 晨星公司（Morningstar）股票分析师塞思 · 戈尔茨坦（Seth Goldstein）认为，如果特斯拉向车主提供的自动驾驶系统比 FSD（监督版）更加先进，那么 Cybercab 收取更高的月度订阅费也有一定合理性。 他向 Business Insider 表示：“更高的 FSD 价格也有其合理性，因为它很可能采用最新版本，领先于面向普通消费者的版本，同时还要用于运营 Robotaxi 业务。”

items.title_zh: AI 智能体擅自转账、购物谁来负责？多家银行警告用户损失可能要自己承担
items.title_en: Who Is Liable When AI Agents Transfer Money or Shop on Their Own? Banks Warn Users May Bear the Losses
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 19 日消息，如果你的 AI 智能体做出了一笔糟糕的财务决策，最终可能只能由你自己承担损失。 这是近期多家大型银行向客户发出的警告。根据 Business Insider 查看的银行邮件和应用通知，银行实际上是在提醒用户：如果 AI 智能体获得了访问金融账户的权限，其执行的操作可能被视为用户本人的行为，而不是外部入侵者实施的操作。 Ally Bank 本月早些时候向客户发送邮件称：“使用 AI 服务时，AI 采取的任何行动都由你负责。AI 可能犯错、产生幻觉、误解你的指令，或者以你意料之外的方式执行指令，从而造成重大损失。” 摩根大通（JPMorgan Chase）也在 11 月发送的邮件中提醒客户：“如果你的信息遭到滥用，已经授权的交易可能无法撤销。” 花旗银行（Citi）则在官网和移动应用中添加了提示横幅，引导用户阅读相关风险说明。页面明确警告：“AI 助手可能犯错，这意味着你可能需要对它造成的错误承担责任。” 这些警告接连出现，正值新一代 AI 智能体逐渐具备自主购物能力之际。 过去，OpenAI 的 ChatGPT、Anthropic 的 Claude 等 AI 模型主要通过文本回答用户问题。如今，Meta 的 Muse、Instinct AI 以及 OpenAI 的 Dots 等在线智能体已经能够代替用户执行实际任务，例如预订机票、预约餐厅，甚至在除臭剂用完之前自动下单购买。 面对这些新工具，零售商也开始调整服务条款。今年 3 月，Business Insider 报道称，塔吉特（Target）修改了客户协议，明确将 AI 智能体代为购物的行为认定为“由用户授权的交易”。 到了 9 月，亚马逊则以安全性和可靠性方面的担忧为由，禁止 Meta 的 Muse 智能体在其网站上代为购物。 银行同样在尝试划清界限：通过正规授权方式将账户连接到 AI 工具，与直接把账户登录凭据交给 AI 工具，并不是一回事。 Axios 上个月报道称，多家大型银行已经发现第三方智能体正在访问客户账户。其中一些操作获得了客户授权，AI 智能体也使用了客户提供的登录凭据。 Business Insider 查看的所有银行邮件都提醒客户，不要向 AI 工具提供用户名、密码、安全验证码等重要信息。 富国银行（Wells Fargo）也表示，客户不应轻易将账户访问权限交给第三方。 该银行一名代表向 Business Insider 表示：“任何技术都不应该在缺乏严格安全措施、明确的客户授权以及保护客户资金和金融信息的防护机制的情况下，被允许代表客户采取行动。” 今年 10 月，在摩根大通的财报电话会议上，该行 CEO 杰米 · 戴蒙（Jamie Dimon）也针对 AI 智能体访问银行账户的问题发出了类似警告。 他表示：“如果人们正在使用这些工具，就应该了解其中的风险。在此期间，我们不会允许任何外部智能体随意进入公司内部系统，因为这会给客户和摩根大通带来太大的风险。” IT之家注意到，这场 AI 安全风险宣传也已经延伸到设备和软件厂商。 苹果最新一代 Mac 系统软件的测试版中，已经加入了相关警告。当用户考虑授予 AI 智能体或应用程序电脑系统级访问权限时，系统会弹出风险提示，提醒用户谨慎授权。
items.summary_en: Several major banks have recently warned customers that if an AI agent is given access to a financial account, actions it performs may be treated as the user’s own rather than as actions by an outside intruder. Ally Bank said in an email earlier this month that when using AI services, any action taken by the AI is the user’s responsibility, and that AI may make mistakes, hallucinate, misunderstand instructions, or execute them in unexpected ways, causing significant losses. JPMorgan Chase reminded customers in a November email that if their information is misused, authorized transactions may not be reversible; Citi added a banner on its website and mobile app warning that AI assistants may make mistakes, meaning users may be responsible for errors caused by them. The report says these warnings come as online agents such as Meta’s Muse, Instinct AI and OpenAI’s Dots can book flights, reserve restaurants or place orders automatically. Target revised its customer agreement in March to classify AI-agent shopping as a 'transaction authorized by the user,' and Amazon in September banned Meta’s Muse from shopping on its site on its behalf, citing security and reliability concerns. Banks are also drawing a line between connecting an account to AI tools through formal authorization and handing login credentials directly to AI tools; Axios reported last month that several major banks had found third-party agents accessing customer accounts, some with customer authorization and using credentials provided by customers. Wells Fargo said customers should not readily give third-party access to accounts; JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon also warned about the issue on an October earnings call, saying the bank would not allow outside agents to enter its internal systems at will because of the risks to customers and JPMorgan. Apple’s latest Mac beta also includes a warning that appears when users consider granting an AI agent or app system-level access.

items.title_en: This smell startup says its AI nose is as good as a human’s
items.summary_zh: 在新泽西州纽瓦克机场附近的一间实验室里，约 30 名经验丰富的人类嗅辨员正逐一梳理地球上的各种气味。他们细致的记录——“坚果味”“桃子味”“海洋味”——会与化学分析交叉比对，为 AI 初创公司 Osmo 所称的全球首个气味基础模型构建丰富的训练数据。创始人 Alex Wiltschko 表示，公司的目标是“让计算机拥有嗅觉”。他说：“气味分子确实是这个星球上大多数物种唯一能说的语言。大多数物种无法通过声音或视觉交流，所以它确实是地球的原始语言。而且从记忆和情感的角度看，它对我们也极其强大。你闻过一次某种气味，可能一辈子都记得；你在街上闻到某种气味，可能就被拉回高中时代。”Wiltschko 声称，过去几个月 Osmo 的模型已达到“人类水平的嗅觉智能”。公司的定义是：该模型在识别和区分气味方面与普通人相当，在创造气味方面与初级香水设计师相当。公司称其技术已被用于香精行业，帮助品牌设计和制造新香氛。公司还称，上个月 Osmo 的 AI 模型在一家全球最大消费品公司中表现优于其内部调香师。Wiltschko 认为，该技术最终可能用于机场威胁检测或疾病诊断。Wiltschko 于 2023 年将这家初创公司从他此前在谷歌大脑（搜索巨头的前 AI 研究实验室）的工作中剥离出来，他正在沿用其他领域 AI 初创公司的打法：把大量数据投入难题，看看会发生什么。
items.summary_en: In a lab near Newark Airport in New Jersey, a team of around 30 experienced human sniffers are slowly working their way through every odor on Earth. Their careful notes—“nutty,” “peachy,” “marine”—are cross-referenced with a chemical analysis to create a rich set of training data for what AI startup Osmo calls the world’s first foundation model for smell. The company’s goal, says founder Alex Wiltschko, is “to give computers a sense of smell.” “Scent molecules are really the only language most species on this planet can speak,” he says. “Most species can’t communicate with sound or visually, so it truly is Earth’s original language. And it’s incredibly powerful for us, from a memory and an emotional standpoint. You can smell something once and remember it for the rest of your life. You can smell something on the street and be pulled back to high school.” In the last few months, Wiltschko claims, Osmo’s model has achieved “human-level olfactory intelligence.” The company’s definition of this is that the model is about as good as the average person at detecting and discriminating between smells, and about as good as a junior perfume designer at creating them. It says its technology is already being used in the fragrance industry to help brands design and manufacture new scents. Last month, the company says, Osmo’s AI model outperformed in-house perfumers at one of the world’s largest consumer goods companies. Wiltschko believes it could be deployed eventually for threat detection at airports, for example, or diagnosing diseases. Wiltschko spun the startup out of his work at Google Brain, the search giant’s former AI research lab, in 2023, and he is running the same playbook as AI startups in other domains: Throw a lot of data at difficult problems, and see what happens. items.summary_zh: 联合创始人 Ary 和 Maria 介绍 Maritime（https://maritime.sh），他们在构建一个“智能体原生”云，处理从自定义环境到 AI 智能体生命周期管理的一切。他们指出，旧金山涌现了大量沙盒（sandbox）公司，但沙盒最多只解决 AI 智能体基础设施问题的 10%；多数沙盒公司的做法是购买 Hetzner/OVH Cloud 裸金属服务器，用 Firecracker 切分成虚拟机后低毛利出售，这是对一个相当困难问题的狭窄解法。他们与数百家构建 AI 智能体的公司交流（从个人助理、编程智能体到医疗等垂直智能体），发现即使选定了沙盒供应商，仍必须自建额外基础设施才能跑通。主要摩擦点：1. 智能体生命周期管理——睡眠/唤醒、持久化存储、触发器、调度、按用户路由与支出上限、健康监控、故障恢复，以及向数千台虚拟机无停机部署更新，这些琐碎的沙盒管理任务都要企业自行构建与维护，累积起来成本很高；2. 自定义环境——生产环境智能体需求各异，有的需要 Windows 应用，有的需要 Android、带持久会话的浏览器、自定义操作系统镜像、预装桌面软件、特定依赖，还有的需要访问私有网络以与客户系统交互……
items.summary_en: Hi HN, we're Ary and Maria, co-founders of Maritime ( https://maritime.sh ). We're building an agent-native cloud that handles everything from custom environments to lifecycle management for AI agents. Demo: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lCWMdBQ96rY There’s been an explosion of sandbox companies coming out of SF, but sandboxes solve maybe 10% of the infrastructure problem for AI agents. The approach that most sandboxing companies take is: You buy Hetzner/OVH Cloud bare metal servers, use Firecracker to slice the servers up into VMs, sell those VMs with low margins. It’s a bit of an oversimplification, but the point is it’s a narrow solution to a fairly difficult problem. We talked to a couple hundred companies that are building AI agents. From personal assistants and coding agents to specialized healthcare agents, and the main pattern we saw was that even after choosing a sandbox provider, you still have to build additional infrastructure just to get things working. These were the primary points of friction: 1. Agent lifecycle management. There’s a lot that you have to build in order to properly give your agents VMs: things like sleep/wake, persistent storage, triggers, scheduling, per-user routing and spend caps, health monitoring, failure recovery, and deploying updates across thousands of VMs without downtime. There are so many of these small sandbox management tasks that companies have to build and maintain themselves, and they add up. 2. Custom environments. Production agents have varying needs. Some agents need Windows applications. Others need Android, browsers with persistent sessions, custom operating system images, preinstalled desktop software and applications, or specific dependencies. items.summary_zh: 据 The Information 报道，Meta 计划将 Muse Charm 定价为 300 美元；这是一款带屏幕的小型设备，可让用户与 Muse AI 智能体对话。CEO 马克·扎克伯格今年早些时候公布了该设备，并表示公司预计在“12 月假日季前”出货，但当时未给出价格。扎克伯格在发布 Muse Charm 时表示，公司已把“完整的 Muse 体验”——包括实时语音与虚拟形象技术——装进这款设备。它配有指纹传感器，点击即可与 Muse AI 智能体对话，无需解锁手机或打开应用。……完整报道见 The Verge。
items.summary_en: Meta is planning to price the Muse Charm, a little gadget with a screen that lets you chat with your Muse AI agent, at $300, according to The Information . CEO Mark Zuckerberg revealed the gadget earlier this year and said the company expected to ship the Charm "in time for the holidays in December," but he didn't provide a price at the time. When he announced the Muse Charm, Zuckerberg said that the company had "packed the whole Muse experience," including real-time voice and avatar technology, into the gadget. It has a fingerprint sensor, and you can tap it to be able to talk to a Muse AI agent without unlocking a phone or opening an app. … Read the full story at The Verge.
items.why_zh: 推测：若该定价属实，表明 Meta 试图用独立硬件承载 AI 智能体，而 300 美元价位将影响其消费级市场的接受度。
items.why_en: Speculation: if the reported price holds, it suggests Meta is betting on dedicated hardware to carry its AI agent, and a $300 price point would shape consumer adoption.
